# SafeWise

> > SafeWise is an independent safety and home security research group that tests, reviews, and compares security systems, cameras, and smart home devices to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions.

SafeWise provides expert-tested product reviews and comprehensive guides for home security systems, wireless cameras, and smart home integration. The site features detailed comparisons between major providers like SimpliSafe, ADT, Vivint, Ring, and emerging brands like Abode and Reolink, with transparent testing methodology and editorial standards.
